primaryReader: Epistemologist of economics / market design evaluator / research program lead
readerProblem: Confusing transactional gross merchandise volume (GMV) with genuine participant welfare and demand-side agency.

propositionLedger.statement: Transaction is not success: completed transactions without constraint satisfaction or outside-option superiority are false positives.
The decision to not aggregate is an equal, valid, and informative research result.
Scientific success is defined by mapping precise failure boundaries rather than maximizing clearing volume.

prohibitedInterpretations: Do not claim specific benchmarks represent universal welfare improvements.
Do not present unobserved metrics as empirical validation.
claimBoundary: Conceptual research framework at Evidence Level E0.
handoff: Closes the 7-module narrative spine into Continuous Rights Gates and Evidence Discipline specifications.
